summary: Full repository audit focused on production controls, agent workflows, secret leakage, model-output validation, and CI gating for Antigravity IDE. Prioritized fixes and safe patches prepared (non-destructive).

changes.title: Secrets committed in .agents/scripts/config.json — redact and provide template
changes.description: Hard-coded API keys and tokens are present in .agents/scripts/config.json and must be removed, rotated, and replaced with a template and .gitignore to prevent future commits.

proposed_fix.explanation: Remove hard-coded secrets, add guidance to use environment variables or a local config that is gitignored; secrets must be rotated outside the repo.

changes.title: Add local_config_template.json and .gitignore to prevent committing secrets
changes.description: Provide a blank template for local configuration and ignore it in git to reduce accidental secret commits.

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds a template that developers can copy to local_config.json (which should be gitignored). This keeps secrets out of the repo while preserving developer ergonomics.

changes.title: Add .agents/scripts/.gitignore to ignore local config & env files
changes.description: Ensure local_config.json and .env are ignored to prevent accidental commits of secrets.

proposed_fix.explanation: Ignore local_config.json and .env in the .agents/scripts folder to prevent committing local secrets.

changes.title: Add model-output validator (Zod) to enforce schema on model responses
changes.description: No repository-level validator exists to ensure model outputs are valid, structured JSON; add tools/validate_model_output.ts using Zod.

evidence.snippet: Repository scaffolding shows multi-agent outputs but no validator/auditor present in repo

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds a strict schema validator to ensure the model output is valid JSON and meets the expected audit schema before any further processing.

changes.title: Add model-output auditor (file existence + git apply --check)
changes.description: Add an auditor script that verifies any file paths referenced by model output exist and that proposed unified diffs pass git apply --check.

evidence.snippet: Multi-AI Debate & Voting Council System (0-Quota / Free Swarm) ... sends tasks to multiple free-tier AI models in parallel

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds an auditor to detect hallucinated file references and to verify that patches are syntactically applicable before human review or automated PR creation.

changes.title: Add tests/webhook.spec.ts to verify raw-body webhook handling
changes.description: Provide a Supertest test skeleton for any Stripe-like webhook endpoints to ensure raw body handling is used where necessary.

evidence.snippet:
## 3. Security Audit with File Context

```bash
python .agents/scripts/council_debate.py --task "Audit for XSS, CSRF, and secret leaks" --file "omnistock/src/App.jsx" --role "SEC-01"
```

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds a test that simulates a raw webhook post to ensure the code can handle raw body verification flows (e.g., Stripe webhooks).

changes.title: Add CI workflow to validate model outputs and run auditor (PR gating)
changes.description: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the validator and auditor on PRs so that model-generated patches are validated before merge.

evidence.snippet:
"dependencies": { "openai": "^6.49.0" }
// No scripts for model-output validation or audit present

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds CI gating that runs the new validator/auditor and prevents merging model-sourced patches that fail validation.

changes.title: Update root package.json to add devDependencies & scripts for validation/auditor/tests
changes.description: Add devDependencies (zod, ts-node, vitest, supertest, eslint) and npm scripts to run validator and auditor easily in CI/local.

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds development tooling needed to run the validator, auditor, and tests in CI. Dependency updates should be non-destructive but test in CI.
proposed_fix.requires_human_review_reason: Dependency changes can affect builds; run in CI and validate.

changes.title: Harden multi-agent runtime: restrict network/API calls without explicit approval
changes.description: The council_debate.py call_api() function will attempt to call external endpoints if tokens are set; add an explicit runtime gate (ENV var) to prevent uncontrolled outbound calls and require human opt-in for networked execution.

proposed_fix.explanation: Adds a runtime safety gate so automated agent code cannot make external API calls unless environment explicitly allows it. This reduces risk of data exfiltration or unapproved API use.

changes.title: Docs: remove guidance encouraging storing tokens in localStorage and checked-in .env
changes.description: Some README files recommend storing tokens in browser localStorage or user .env under C:\Users which encourages insecure practices. Update docs to recommend environment variables, local_config_template, and secrets managers.

evidence.snippet: 3. **Zero-Quota Law**: Subagents CANNOT make paid API calls or consume Antigravity quota.

proposed_fix.explanation: Removes insecure instructions and points users to safe alternatives (env vars, local_config_template.json, and CI secrets).

ci_workflows.explanation: CI workflow to run validator, auditor, lint and tests on PRs to prevent merging bad model-generated patches
ci_workflows.workflow_snippet:
name: Validate Model Output & Repo Checks
on: [pull_request]

agent_policy_changes.review_requirements: No approvals required for read actions; cannot change code.

agent_policy_changes.role: Validate model outputs and open issues
agent_policy_changes.review_requirements: If any model output flagged requires_human_review, escalate to human security-officer.

agent_policy_changes.role: Apply low-risk patches and open PRs
agent_policy_changes.review_requirements: All patches with severity >= high OR requires_human_review=true require explicit human approval before merge.
Deploy only after CI green and a human approval token is recorded in the audit log.
